metas.name: The Silence of Swastika
metas.description: Hitler used a symbol for his political and racial ideology. The world today calls that symbol "Swastika", an Indian name to a symbol used by Hindus, Buddhists, and Jains for ages. But was it a Swastika? or Something else?

metas.name: Baththa
metas.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally locks a feared criminal inside a school restroom. As the man faces hunger and isolation, an unexpected friendship forms between them, transforming both their lives.

metas.name: Comrade Kalyan
metas.description: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

metas.name: Immortal
metas.description: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: 12th Fail
metas.description: The real-life story of IPS Officer Manoj Kumar Sharma and IRS Officer Shraddha Joshi.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: Mulshi Pattern
metas.description: A stark portrayal of the hardships faced by farmers, Mulshi Pattern tackles some of the raging issues of our times. The film lays bare the deep flaws of the system which turns the farmer into a criminal and a social outcast.

metas.name: Tumbbad
metas.description: A mythological story about a goddess who created the entire universe. The plot revolves around the consequences when humans build a temple for her first-born.

metas.name: Pelli Choopulu
metas.description: A wannabe businesswoman and a happy-go-lucky guy meet each other during an arranged marriage blind date but eventually team up to start a food truck on their own.

metas.name: Casino
metas.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

metas.name: Jurassic Park
metas.description: An industrialist invites some experts to visit his theme park of cloned dinosaurs. After a power failure, the creatures run loose, putting everyone's lives, including his grandchildren's, in danger.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: Seven years after burying a dark secret, a cinema owner and his family face a renewed investigation led by a relentless new inspector and a grieving mother. New witnesses and forensic traps threaten to shatter their peaceful life.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: A documentary tribute to the series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company, in line with the 25th anniversary of HBO's original limited series.

metas.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Kantara
metas.description: When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.

metas.name: On the Waterfront
metas.description: An ex-prize fighter turned New Jersey longshoreman struggles to stand up to his corrupt union bosses, including his older brother, as he starts to connect with the grieving sister of one of the syndicate's victims.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Donnie Darko
metas.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: Paul Atreides arrives on Arrakis after his father accepts the stewardship of the dangerous planet. However, chaos ensues after a betrayal as forces clash to control melange, a precious resource.

metas.name: Blade Runner 2049
metas.description: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: Ankhon Dekhi
metas.description: After a distressing incident, a Delhi man vows to believe only what he can see, but his new ideals soon take his life in extreme directions.

metas.name: Anjaam Pathiraa
metas.description: The police are on the trail of a serial killer, but with the victims being fellow officers, will they be able to catch the killer and solve the case in time?

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: Article 370
metas.description: Ahead of a major constitutional decision, special agent Zooni Haksar is tasked with a secret mission to quell violence in a conflict-ridden region.

metas.name: Udta Punjab
metas.description: A story that revolves around drug abuse in the affluent north Indian State of Punjab and how the youth there have succumbed to it en-masse resulting in a socio-economic decline.

metas.name: Raazi
metas.description: A Kashmiri woman agrees to marry a Pakistani army officer in order to spy on Pakistan during the Indo-Pakistan War of 1971.

metas.name: Sir
metas.description: A prosperous young Indian man falls in love with his servant, a widow with the dream of becoming a fashion designer.

metas.name: Star Trek Into Darkness
metas.description: After the crew of the Enterprise find an unstoppable force of terror from within their own organization, Captain Kirk leads a manhunt to a war-zone world to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

metas.name: Chatrapathi
metas.description: Displaced Sri Lankans in a Vizag port are ruled by a local rowdy. This is the story of Chatrapati Sivaji who overcomes this oppression and how he reunites with his long lost mother and brother.

metas.name: Saw
metas.description: Two men awaken to find themselves on the opposite sides of a dead body, each with specific instructions to kill the other, escape or face the consequences. These two are the latest contestants in Jigsaw's games.

metas.name: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...
metas.description: After marrying a poor woman, rich Rahul is disowned by his father and moves to London to build a new life. Years later, his now-grown younger brother Rohan embarks on a mission to bring Rahul back home and reunite the family.

metas.name: Viduthalai Part 2
metas.description: An unassuming school teacher faces extreme circumstances, forcing him to take up arms and lead a fiery rebellion against oppression, becoming an unlikely leader.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A shy student trying to reach his family in Ohio, a gun-toting bruiser in search of the last Twinkie and a pair of sisters striving to get to an amusement park join forces in a trek across a zombie-filled America.

metas.name: The Crow
metas.description: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the mantle of the Crow, a supernatural...

metas.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

metas.name: Eleven
metas.description: A brave and skilled officer with a strong record of solving tough cases is assigned to a new, more challenging serial killing investigation.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: Aravindha Sametha
metas.description: A young scion of a powerful family with a long history of violence decides to put an end to the bloodshed which leads him to a path of self discovery.

metas.name: Poltergeist
metas.description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

metas.name: Gold
metas.description: The journey of a man who was instrumental in making India win its first Olympic gold medal as a free nation.

metas.name: Phir Hera Pheri
metas.description: A twist of fate changes the lives of Raju, Shyam and Baburao when they get cheated by a fraudster. They must now find a way to repay a loan taken from a dreaded gangster.

metas.name: Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: Excalibur
metas.description: Merlin the magician helps Arthur Pendragon unite the Britons around the Round Table of Camelot, even as dark forces conspire to tear it apart.

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: The story of Theranos, a multi-billion dollar tech company, its founder Elizabeth Holmes, the youngest self-made female billionaire, and the massive fraud that collapsed the company.
